A research prototype that turns spoken English into Slovak or Czech captions and speech.

Real-Time Speech Translation turns spoken English into Slovak or Czech captions and speech while the speaker is still talking. It is a local-first research prototype for meetings and presentations, where listeners need captions and translated speech from a single source.
